findings.statement: Within tested 4x5/5x4 geometries, cycle opportunity and cocycle frustration are separate structural layers: k=2 has no fundamental cycles; k=3 and k=4 have cycles, but 4x5 remains flat while 5x4 is frustrated.

In the tested k=3 neighborhood {4x4,5x3,4x5,5x4}, only 5x4 has nonzero fundamental-cycle syndrome. Width 5 alone and height 4 alone are each insufficient within this finite neighborhood; their conjunction selects the sole obstructed case.

Mover final-cap parity pruning changes raw residual-state counts but leaves recursive unlabelled classes, action-labelled classes, deeper-group structure, cycle rank and syndrome census unchanged at each fixed frontier setting for both 4x5 and 5x4 k=4.
findings.scope: 2x2 frontier/cap ablation on exact k=4 transposed cases

findings.statement: The nonterminal frontier blocker changes binary-cycle topology and reduces 5x4 nonzero fundamental syndromes from 79 to 25, but does not change the flat/obstructed classification of either 4x5 or 5x4.

In the k=4 line-family intervention, H+D is the unique minimum winning-line-family subset that produces any 5x4 nonzero syndrome; H, V, D, H+V and V+D are flat. Vertical lines are not necessary. The same H+D subset is flat in 4x5.
findings.scope: counterfactual residual producer; not standard Connect-Four rule theorem

findings.statement: Activating opponent-open-cap terminal-dominance pruning changes raw state carriers but leaves cycle rank, nonzero syndrome count and contradictory-reconvergence count exactly unchanged for both standard 4x5 and 5x4 k=4.

Deep, transport-only recursive quotient merging is not sufficient for cocycle obstruction: flat 4x5 has earliest rank-9 merges requiring depth 4-9 and transport in every child class, comparable to obstructed 5x4 depth 7-9.

Among exact open-cap class-preserving deletions not explained by support-release timing, all 2861 in flat 4x5 are terminal-dominated, while only 2299 of 3755 in obstructed 5x4 are. This coverage gap is a clue but is not causally sufficient because terminal-dominance pruning leaves the cocycle unchanged.
findings.scope: audited standard k=4 cases plus pruning intervention

findings.statement: The unique minimum contradictory 5x4 source-target witness under (total traversals, max route length, distinct edges) uses four distinct transitions: two length-2 routes with opposite parity.

Even the full eight-feature coarse cycle signature (parent rank, closing column, path length, length parity, distinct-column count, repeat flag, source out-degree, target in-degree) does not determine syndrome; an exact zero/nonzero matched-signature pair exists.

Parent rank plus the full first-occurrence-relabelled action-column word is a perfect finite classifier on the k=4 685-cycle family, but the k=3 holdout does not confirm frustrated-cycle transfer: all 23 holdout nonzero cycles use previously unseen keys; 68 seen keys are all zero and predicted correctly.

Refinement and binary-linear canonicalization reduce permutation-candidate enumeration by orders of magnitude while preserving state count, recursive class count, root value and earliest merge rank in both 4x5 and 5x4 controls.

The k=4 minimum-family rule does not transfer to k=3. On 5x4 k=3, H alone is already obstructed (2 nonzero syndromes), V+D is also obstructed (10), while V and D individually are flat. Thus the inclusion-minimal obstructing family sets are {H} and {V,D}, not {H,D}.

Every tested 4x5 k=3 line-family subset remains flat, including the exact transpose counterparts of obstructed 5x4 subsets. Therefore line-family membership by itself does not determine cocycle frustration even at fixed k.
findings.scope: all seven H/V/D family subsets on 4x5 and 5x4 k=3

findings.statement: Selected obstructed 5x4 line systems and flat 4x5 counterparts are exact coordinate-transpose isomorphs of the static winning-line hypergraph, with identical cell-incidence degree and line-intersection multisets. Their cocycle classifications nevertheless differ, so static winning-line incidence up to transpose does not determine the dynamic residual cocycle.
findings.scope: T-K4-HD, T-K3-H, T-K3-HV and T-K3-VD exact transpose pairs

findings.statement: Within the tested transpose pairs, coordinate transpose is a symmetry of the static winning-line system but not of the gravity/support transition system. A load-bearing differentiator must therefore include gravity-relative transition semantics rather than only the static line hypergraph.
findings.scope: selected exact k=3/k=4 transpose pairs under standard downward gravity

findings.statement: For 5x4 k=3, nonzero-syndrome count is not monotone under adding winning-line families: H gives 2, H+V 43, H+D 6, V+D 10, and H+V+D 23. Family addition can increase or decrease frustration magnitude even though all tested supersets of an obstructing minimum remain obstructed.

Exact remaining-move-capacity and gravity support-release/turn-capacity pruning do not remove the 5x4 obstruction. At k=4 both reduce the carrier and shrink the cocycle from 644 cycles / 25 nonzero / 12 contradictions to 542 / 22 / 1, but global phase remains nonintegrable. At k=3 the cocycle census remains exactly 451 / 23 / 18.
findings.scope: standard 4x5/5x4 k3/k4 producer with frontier+cap closures

findings.statement: In every tested 4x5/5x4 k3/k4 case, remaining-move-capacity and support-release/turn-capacity closures produce identical recursive/action-labelled class counts and identical binary cocycle summaries, even when their raw residual-orbit state counts differ. The finer release filter adds no cocycle distinction beyond remaining capacity in this scope.

Static line-hypergraph incidence plus individual residual realizability under remaining-move and support-release/turn constraints are jointly insufficient to explain the flat/frustrated transpose split. The unresolved differentiator must lie in other gravity-relative transition structure, such as interaction/order among realizable continuations, not merely static incidence or single-residual feasibility.
findings.scope: tested transpose pairs and exact realizability closures

live_gap.statement: Which gravity-relative interaction/order feature of realizable continuations produces the one robust 5x4 k4 contradiction and the k3 obstruction family remains unresolved.
fixed_by_latest: static winning-line hypergraph up to transpose is insufficient
line-family labels do not transfer as a universal rule across k
support-release filtering adds no cocycle distinction beyond remaining capacity in the tested cases
5x4 k4 nevertheless retains exactly one contradictory reconvergence after the stronger closure

do not infer transition identity from static transpose isomorphism
do not treat a pruned-away contradiction as explanation of the surviving one
